children: Announcement according to article 2 of the Regulation (EU) 2016/1052 Munich (pta/09.11.2026/16:48) - In the period from November 2, 2026 until and including November 8, 2026, a total of 1,539,908 shares were acquired as part of the share buyback of Siemens Energy AG. On September 23, 2026 the start of the share buyback for September 24, 2026 was announced pursuant to Art. 5 para. 1 lit. a) of the Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014 and Art. 2 para. 1 of the Delegated Regulation (EU) No. 2016/1052. Shares were acquired as follows: Day of purchase Trading Venue Aggregated volume of shares Weighted average price (EUR) 02.11.2026 XETRA 237,204 129.3982 CBOE DXE 29,207 129.1935 Aquis Exchange 13,723 129.0506 Turquoise Europe 13,646 129.1085 Total 293,780 129.3482 03.11.2026 XETRA 236,973 129.8941 CBOE DXE 29,891 129.6447 Aquis Exchange 12,923 129.5347 Turquoise Europe 12,873 129.6808 Total 292,660 129.8434 04.11.2026 XETRA 241,225 124.7386 CBOE DXE 35,537 125.3811 Aquis Exchange 14,760 125.1665 Turquoise Europe 12,824 125.2889 Total 304,346 124.8576 05.11.2026 XETRA 231,611 118.4218 CBOE DXE 49,988 117.3762 Aquis Exchange 19,993 117.6443 Turquoise Europe 19,994 117.6694 Total 321,586 118.1642 06.11.2026 XETRA 262,968 116.0597 CBOE DXE 38,122 115.8885 Aquis Exchange 13,703 115.8280 Turquoise Europe 12,743 115.7408 Total 327,536 116.0177 The transactions are also published on the website of Siemens Energy AG (www.siemens-energy.com/sharebuyback). The total number of shares which were acquired as part of the share buyback in the time period from September 24, 2026 until and including November 8, 2026 amounts to 7,390,216 shares. The purchase of the shares of Siemens Energy AG is carried out by an institution commissioned by Siemens Energy AG. The shares are acquired exclusively on the electronic trading platform of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (Xetra) and the multilateral trading systems CBOE DXE, Aquis Exchange Europe and Turquoise Europe.
